component.name: Flocon
component.summary: Debug your Android, iOS and KMP apps from your desktop

description.p: Flocon is a debugging companion for mobile apps. Connect your app with the Flocon SDK and inspect what it does from your desktop.

ul.li: Network calls: HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket and gRPC, with mocks and bad network simulation
Databases, SharedPreferences, DataStore and the app files
Analytics events, feature flags, crash reports and deeplinks
Screenshots and screen recordings of Android devices through adb
